data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'winos', meaning friend or beloved. The name Win also holds the significance of victory in various spiritual traditions. In Christianity, Win is associated with the Roman martyr Saint Winibald, who is celebrated for his devotion and victory over adversity. The name Win carries the meaning “Friend, Beloved, Victor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Win usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, beloved, victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
